price_snapshot_notice: Published snapshot, not availability, latency, quality or price guarantee. Recheck checkout and endpoint price at use time.

standard.fee_formula: sum_j max(0.055*C_j, 0.80), for actual nonzero credit purchases C_j; zero purchases imply zero purchase fee

business.fee_formula: 0.08*C established; a Business-specific minimum is not explicitly documented in reviewed pages. Do not invent zero or copy 0.80 as confirmed.

fees.applies_to: Credits purchased, not a separate markup added to each request
unknowns: Crypto total fee interaction with Business fee
checkout tax and transaction-specific payment fees

byok.threshold_metric: Equivalent OpenRouter model/provider list-price inference volume, NOT actual discounted provider invoice and NOT request count

scope.published: Plan-dependent monthly allowance; plan belongs to account or organization; account-level credits/billing unified across workspaces
scope.calculator_assumption: ONE allowance for the represented billing account/organization across all scenario model instances. Never multiply by developers, API keys, providers or workspaces.
scope.uncertainty: Reviewed pages do not explicitly define the allowance ledger scope/reset timezone/proration in one precise clause. Billing-account aggregation is a conservative inference from pricing and workspaces; verify contract/account UI if threshold matters.

byok.cash_total_formula: actual_provider_invoice D + BYOK_fee F + shared_fallback_inference S + paid_tools T + applicable fee on credits actually purchased to fund F+S+T (net of eligible credit balance/grant). Do not charge 5.5%/8% on D as if it were OpenRouter prepaid inference.

example.assumptions: No existing credits, no eligible grant, no fee waiver, no tools/fallback/tax, one topup; provider invoice=list shadow usage for this illustrative case only.

eligibility: Pre-Series B venture-scalable startup or founder
Professional email matches company domain and identifies an individual; generic admin/support/ops aliases not accepted
Less than USD500 lifetime OpenRouter spend
No previous startup credits; one grant per applicant across partners
calculator_rules: Disabled by default until approved. Use actual awarded balance and expiry date.
Apply grant only to eligible OpenRouter-billed spend before expiry, not directly to third-party BYOK inference invoices.
Fee waiver sets relevant platform/BYOK fee to zero while active; do not combine it with an additional negative percentage discount.
Do not subtract USD3000 every month or divide automatically over twelve months. Track consumption over time.
No assumption that grant applies to every paid plugin or every special contract; specific eligibility may need award terms.
Provider endpoint pricing already includes shown price discounts; no extra multiplication by discount metadata.

calculation_contract.route_identity: Stable model_id + exact provider_tag + provider_model_instance_id. Different tiers/regions/quantizations are separate routes. Never mix minimum input from one route with cached/output rate from another.
calculation_contract.request_cost_formula: (uncached_tokens*P + cache_write_tokens*W + cache_read_tokens*R + billed_output_tokens*O)/1e6 + separately selected tools/request fees; input token categories disjoint.
calculation_contract.write_share_definition: w=share of non-hit input billed at write tariff; write price replaces ordinary input price. Not an extra full-price add-on.
calculation_contract.context: Choose per-request context band before multiplying rates; monthly aggregate exceeding threshold does not trigger long-context rate. Exact request at min_prompt_tokens boundary follows API predicate; do not infer boundary from rounded context names.
calculation_contract.time: HHMM UTC numeric intervals in override records, end exclusive, end=0 means midnight. Apply absolute matching override rate, not another percentage. Separate time regimes or token/cost-weighted fractions; fraction of hours is not fraction of tokens without uniform-traffic assumption.

explicit_deepseek_schedule.public_holiday_passthrough: Not encoded in observed OpenRouter overrides. Do not assume direct-provider Chinese holiday discount automatically applies on OR.

calculation_contract.unknown_override_precedence: If future endpoint has overlapping time/context overrides, do not multiply or invent precedence; current selected OpenAI context-only and DeepSeek time-only are separately unambiguous.
calculation_contract.reasoning: Billed output must include charged reasoning tokens; visible output alone understates spend.
calculation_contract.fees: Group credit funding by actual billing account and purchases, not per model row or developer; amortized percentage mode separate from exact cash/topup mode.
calculation_contract.byok: One allowance per modeled billing account/month across model instances as explicit conservative assumption; maintain existing usage input. Do not multiply allowance by keys, workspaces, seats or routes.
calculation_contract.defaults: Startup off; grant zero; no automatic Enterprise discount; nonzero endpoint status excluded; taxes/tools not fabricated; explicitly selected route not auto-cheapest.
calculation_contract.variance: Model stochastic behavior, retry count, cache hit ratio, provider availability and price changes not measured.
